abstract.para: Wireshark is an open source network protocol analyzer used for network troubleshooting, analysis, software and communications protocol development and education. Because Wireshark parses a wide array of complex network protocols, it frequently receives updates to address security vulnerabilities (CVEs) and expand protocol support.

topic.para: Wireshark follows the balanced lifecycle model. Wireshark packages are maintained and updated according to the following rules:

listitem.para: Wireshark is categorized under the balanced lifecycle model to balance strict stability with the need for timely security patching and protocol analysis capabilities.

Maintenance updates are delivered continuously within &suselinux; 16 minor releases, as well as for previously released minor releases in maintenance. These releases focus strictly on security fixes (CVEs) and bug repairs. To ensure stability, maintenance updates contain no new or changed features.

Minor version updates are performed with a new &suselinux; 16 minor release (every release or every second release). These updates align &suselinux; 16 with the latest upstream stable branch, introducing new protocol dissectors and features.

When upstream releases a new major version, &suse; carefully evaluates whether to transition to that major release on a case-by-case basis. Any major version transitions will be fully documented in the release notes.
